national.override_reason: Adopted 2026-10-11 although it beat the national series in only 5 of 9 years (rule: 6). Lower mean error (2.73 vs 3.18) and 2023+ error, larger wins than losses, a structurally weaker alternative (no market-activity data), and coherence with the metro forecasts. Rural ZIPs use it only if their backtest error isn't worse.
